comment: One row of GET /v1/sessions, and the whole body of GET /v1/registry/<session_id>, for a live Envoy session with no interest record, no role claim and no capability. packages/envoy/cmd/listener/api_test.go builds the session entry from after_this_change and compares the listener's raw row with it; packages/envoy-client/src/__tests__/transport.test.ts serves both rows to listSessions.
